_help: STAFF CONTENT: Change routes descriptions and groups here (no code). Commit; GitHub Actions automatically rebuilds and publishes. Frequency overrides are manual exceptions, not the preferred source. See STAFF_EDITING_GUIDE.md.
_how_to_edit_route_descriptions: Each route's description (shown in the route list and on the route's page) is under "routes" below, by route number.
To change one: edit only the text between the quotes after the route number. Keep the quotes and the comma at the end of the line.
To use the description from GMT's GTFS (if it has one), leave the quotes empty: "".
A new route? Add a line like  "12": "Downtown to the airport via Airport Drive.",  (any position is fine).
Commit the change on GitHub: the map rebuilds and publishes within a few minutes. A typo in a route number shows as a warning, not an error.
_how_to_edit_route_list_lines: The short line under each route's name in the route list (e.g. "Daily · weekdays every 20 min, 35 min evenings") is worked out from the schedule.
To write your own for a route, put it between the quotes after the route number under "legend_lines". Keep the quotes and the comma.
Leave the quotes empty ("") to keep the automatic line. The live bus count ("· 4 live") is still added after your text.

trip_costs._help: Used for 'Save about $X vs. driving' in the trip planner. Update gas_price (and gas_price_as_of) every few months. Per-mile costs are cents per mile.
trip_costs.maintenance_source: AAA Your Driving Costs 2025, small sedan (maintenance, repair and tires)
trip_costs.depreciation_source: Estimate of the extra loss in a used compact car's value from added miles
trip_costs.fare_note: $2 a ride; with the Ride Ready by GMT app or smart card, fares stop at $4 a day and $50 a month (25 rides). Discounted fare $1. Shopping Specials are free.
trip_costs.mpg_source: 2021 statewide average fuel economy of Vermont's light-duty vehicles (Vermont energy planning data from VTrans and partners)

frequency_overrides._help: Manual frequency settings for the frequency map, in minutes between buses. A setting REPLACES the timetable figure for that route and period (faster or slower); leave a route empty {} to use the timetable (measured by departures from the Downtown Transit Center, or Amtrak for Route 4). Periods: peak (rush hour 7-9 AM and 4-6 PM), mid (midday 9 AM-3 PM), eve (evening 7-10 PM). Add "inbound_only": true to apply a setting only on trips heading to the Downtown Transit Center. Streets shared by several routes add their buses together.

amenity_overrides._help: Amenities set for stops whose name contains this text, whatever the stop survey says.
